characters.name: Halvor
characters.prompt: A determined young Norwegian man from the 1400s, wearing tattered, sooty peasant clothing. He has scruffy brown hair, a lean build, and a brave demeanor, hinting at hidden strength and courage.

characters.name: First Princess
characters.prompt: A regal Norwegian princess from the 1400s with long braided hair. She wears a simple yet elegant gown in soft colors, looking relieved and grateful after being rescued from a three-headed troll.

characters.name: Second Princess
characters.prompt: A graceful princess from old Norway, wearing a slightly more ornate gown than her sister. Her hair is gathered in an intricate style, and she stands poised and dignified after escaping a six-headed troll.

characters.name: Youngest Princess
characters.prompt: The most radiant of the three Norwegian princesses, clad in a lavish, flowing gown of rich fabrics. She has a gentle yet confident gaze and exudes a quiet majesty, freed from the fiercest nine-headed troll.

characters.name: Three-Headed Troll
characters.prompt: A towering monstrous creature with three heads, coarse grey skin, and tusk-like teeth. It wears ragged clothing, each head snarling with a fearsome expression, looming in a dimly lit castle kitchen.

characters.name: Six-Headed Troll
characters.prompt: An immense troll with six menacing heads of varying expressions. Its rough skin is mossy green, and it stands hunched in a grand Norwegian hall, wielding an oversized battle-worn sword.

characters.name: Nine-Headed Troll
characters.prompt: A gargantuan, hulking figure with nine bristling heads. Its formidable presence fills the ancient castle chamber, each head roaring in fury, set against torchlit stone walls.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a grand Norwegian castle from the 1400s perched atop a rugged mountain landscape, with Halvor standing boldly holding a gleaming sword. Next to him are the three princesses wearing medieval gowns, relieved to be rescued, while in the distance stand the defeated three-headed, six-headed, and nine-headed trolls. The era should feel authentically old and the setting reflect a distant, enchanted Norway.
modernMainImagePrompt: Visualize a contemporary Norwegian city skyline with a sleek modern building standing in for Soria Moria. Halvor appears as a modern young traveler in casual clothes, wielding a symbolic object instead of a sword. The three princesses in stylish modern dresses celebrate their freedom from three imposing, futuristic troll-like creatures. Keep the essence of their bravery and each troll’s menacing appearance, but represent them in modern, technological forms.
childMainImagePrompt: Show a friendly, fairy-tale style Norwegian castle sitting atop a gentle green hill, with a smiling Halvor in simple clothes and a cartoonish sword. Three cheerful princesses in bright, colorful dresses gather around him. The trolls in the background should look funny rather than scary, each with a different number of googly-eyed heads, creating a playful and safe illustration for a five-year-old audience.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Lag et bilde av et gammelt norsk slott på et fjell i gammel tid. Halvor står foran slottet i enkle klær og holder et sverd. De tre prinsessene, i vakre kjoler, smiler ved siden av ham. De tre trollene med 3, 6 og 9 hoder er nettopp beseiret i bakgrunnen. Stemningen skal være eventyrlig og norsk fra en svunnen tid.
englishMainImagePrompt: Depict an ancient Norwegian castle high on a rocky mountainside, reflecting the 1400s era. Halvor stands in tattered clothing, sword in hand, triumphant after rescuing three princesses dressed in medieval gowns. The menacing trolls with three, six, and nine heads lurk defeated nearby, highlighting the magical atmosphere of this classic folktale.
